text:
iris: Quick thread for release notes trim-down. We need: concise changelog lines, final SDK snippet sync, and one known-issue about embeddings parameter rename.
anya: I'll take the changelog bullets. Keep each under 80 chars. Target: publish Tue 09:00 PT.
marta: PRs needing attention: #455 (python snippets), #462 (migration guide links), #468 (known-issues repro).
docs-bot: link-checker: 3 broken links detected -> /docs/dedicated/old-auth, /docs/api/embeddings-v1, /docs/snippets/py/old-example. Ticket #854 created.
iris: Marta can you patch redirects and add micro-note in migration guide: "old_auth -> new_auth_system"?
marta: On it. Adding 301s and a one-line redirect page. Also adding a small curl example for the migration guide.
leo: For Python snippet in #455, I changed client init to `RedwoodClient()` and updated streaming to `for chunk in client.stream(...)`. Posting snippet below.

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
for chunk in client.stream('gpt-open-7b', prompt='Summarize the doc'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```

gavin: Looks good. Add a comment about cost differences and mention `max_sequence` rename.
anya: Changelog bullets drafts: 
- "SDK: migration to RedwoodClient (streaming API updated)"
- "Embeddings endpoint superseded; see migration guide"
- "Tiered routing: improved fallback policies"
Keep them short.
iris: Nice. For public copy, use "superseded" not "deprecated" per product.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: started for docs/release-176.
marta: Redirect PR #462 opened. Requesting review from @anya.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: failed -> error: unresolved link /docs/api/embeddings-v1 in migration guide.
leo: I forgot to update the migration guide reference to the new endpoint. Pushing a small fix.
leo: Also added a tiny Node snippet parity update in /docs/snippets/node/stream.md.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: success -> preview at https://deploy-preview-162.docs.redwood.ai
anya: Good. Quick checklist before merge: snippets render correctly, link-checker clean, changelog bullets under 80 chars, known-issues include repro.
marta: Known-issues PR #468 added repro: run quantized model with long prefix -> last token truncated. Included curl that shows truncated output and suggested workaround: pin `max_sequence=1024`.
iris: Perfect. Merge order: #462 (redirects), #455 (snippets), #468 (known-issues). I'll merge once CI is green.
docs-bot: all checks passed for #462, #455, #468.
iris: Merged. Running final `make docs-build` locally.
docs-bot: site build passed.
anya: I'll assemble the release note and post in #announcements tomorrow morning. Thanks all :tada:
